payload.title: messaging-service channels carry no module: an AI channel bound to a module persona admits any active tenant user through addChannelMember, and its messages, including farm data the AI retrieved, are readable on channel membership alone, because the caller capabilities messaging resolves contain no module grants
evidence: apps/messaging-service/src/channel/entities/channel.entity.ts:95 (a channel stores aiPersona but has no module column)
apps/messaging-service/src/channel/commands/add-member.handler.ts:66 (admission checks only that the target is an active tenant user; DIRECT at :78 is the only type refused)
apps/messaging-service/src/channel/resolvers/channel.resolver.ts:199 (the persona capability is checked for the creator, at creation only)
apps/messaging-service/src/ai/services/ai-caller-capabilities.service.ts:47 (resolved caller capabilities are roles and resourcePermissions, with no module grants)
payload.rule_violated: D4 (messaging is module-scoped) and the decided channel default that module channels, AI channels included, are usable only by holders of that module.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-25, release R5.
